thesis_triggers.event: At ~$125 the EV is ~$7.06B (53.2M x $125 + $406.1M net debt at the 2026-10-01 close), ~11.6x the ~$610M median FY28E RemainCo EBITDA (estimate: median of the agents' $635M/$600M/$581M/$625M/$610M) and ~15x FY27E (7,056 / our FY27 continuing 469.8 = 15.0x), in the lower part of the refreshed peer range (7.8x-18.6x consensus NTM EV/EBITDA on 2026-10-23; CARR 11.1x). That fits only DC growth or the $4B CY27-29 capacity agreement breaking (deferral or loss of the customer that was ~11% of consolidated FY26 sales per the 10-K, ~30% of DC sales if all DC (estimate), share loss, chiller-light designs) or an AI-capex down-cycle, not ordinary ~70% volatility (estimate: 1-year daily log-return volatility of Twelve Data closes to 2026-10-05 = 71%). Four of five agents are at $125 and agent_3 at $120. Reviewed 2026-11-03 (Q2 FY27): kept at $125. The print raised DC and CHVAC sales guides, record DC orders >$1B and a $400M award (slides 4/7 [src 76]), so the break's condition (DC growth stalling or the capacity agreement breaking) has not happened; the stock closing at it on 11-03 is price, not the fundamental trigger. Net debt is now 406.1 (was ~280) at the close, which moves EV at $125 up ~$0.13B (126 x 1/1e3), immaterial to the multiple read. Call pass 2026-11-04: stock -21.4% on the day (close 98.56; intraday low 91.42, Twelve Data) (implied move 20.8%, so ~1.15x, under the 2x trigger); the call reaffirmed the raised sales guide and gave the H2 margin cadence, so the fundamental condition still has not occurred. CORRECTION 2026-11-04 4:55pm ET (Kilian: timing): the 11-04 open 115.5 was already -7.9% below the 11-03 close 125.45 and the low 91.42 came in the session (Twelve Data daily bars); the session split from minute bars (adhoc/move_attrib.py: after-hours 11-03 +0.9%, pre-market -14.0%, open-11am -10.0%) is our own unpublished calculation, not a cited figure, so the timing read (print taken flat, fall after the Texas results) is a judgment alongside DC peers with no print (daily closes 11-03 -> 11-04, Twelve Data: VRT 235.97 -> 205.55 = -12.9%, NVT 129.26 -> 112.82 = -12.7%, VST 139.59 -> 120.29 = -13.8%; MOD 125.45 -> 98.56 = -21.4%). So the move is mostly the midterms/Texas, about -8 to -9% beyond peers (higher DC beta and/or a re-read of the margin miss, not separable); the 1.15x-implied test is the wrong frame (the straddle priced the print, not the election). No escalation either way: policy news is priced in dc_mor.
